label: Non-concrete-priority rival of the simple-priority bridge survives, checked
meaning: Rival test for the simple-priority bridge against its smallest consumer, NecessaryFirstBeing.necessaryFirst (premises: concrete population, whole-roster nontrapping, contingent dependence, excluded middle, the simple-priority bridge). With a non-concrete item simply prior to the one necessary concrete root, the rival holds with the other four premises and that root is not a first being. Model-witnessed survival only.
